source: function readServicePlanHandle(id,actor){const name=servicePlanRecoveryStorage+id+'.'+actor;try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(name);if(raw===null)return null;let h;try{h=JSON.parse(raw)}catch(e){}const uuid=x=>typeof x==='string'&&/^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}$/.test(x);if(new TextEncoder().encode(raw).length>640||!h||typeof h!=='object'||Array.isArray(h)||Object.keys(h).sort().join(',')!==servicePlanRecoveryFields.join(',')||h.v!==1||h.id!==id||h.actor!==actor||!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(h.actor)||![h.id,h.key,h.case,h.run].every(uuid)||!Number.isSafeInteger(h.revision)||!['ADOPT','BEGIN','REPORT_FAILURE','RETRY','VERIFY','LOCK','UNLOCK'].includes(h.action)||(h.action==='ADOPT'?(h.step!==null||h.revision<0||h.revision>64||(h.plan===null?h.revision!==0:!uuid(h.plan))):(!uuid(h.plan)||!uuid(h.step)||h.revision<1||h.revision>63))){localStorage.removeItem(name);return null;}return h;}catch(e){return null;}}
proposed_minimum: Restore Number.isFinite(expires), expires > now, expires <= now + 86400000 in same reader; no schema/key/replay/permission changes
